conventions.time_grid: cell midpoints, sample-and-hold, t0 = dt/2, T = N*dt
conventions.phi_vz: the played pulse realises W = R_z(phi_vz).U_target; apply phi_vz as a virtual Z after the pulse, or use the *_vzfree.csv variant
conventions.drive_frequency: on resonance with the bare f01; no offset needed
conventions.phi_vz_fit: fitted on the exported samples themselves, not inherited from a finer grid -- see make_delivery.py's module docstring

Ypi.provenance: exact frame rotation of X(pi) by phi_axis = pi/2 (not an independent solve)
